svg.title: B12 / VULCAN DOMESCAN — O’Leary Emplacement Reconstruction engineering mission profile
svg.desc: B12, VULCAN DOMESCAN — O’Leary Emplacement Reconstruction. Original project: Identifying unique emplacement characteristics of O'Leary Peak: a volcanic dome in the San Francisco Volcanic Field. Session B: Earth & Environmental Engineering. Scientific question: Which emplacement histories explain dome morphology, fabrics and contacts while respecting mapped stratigraphy? Testable hypothesis: Multiple pulses or variable rheology may explain morphology better than homogeneous extrusion; independent contact/fabric evidence is needed to discriminate those alternatives..
